title: Atlascope instance manifest
description: manifest.yaml: every Atlascope instance whose metadata lives in this repository.

id.description: Short stable key for the instance.

directory.description: Top-level directory holding the instance's atlas-layers/, reference-layers/ and coverage-list.json.

deployUrl.description: Public URL of the deployed Atlascope instance; null until it is deployed.

objectKey.description: Object key within the bucket, without a leading slash; null when not configured.

targets.description: Where the publish pipeline writes the instance's production files. Leave values null until the instance is ready to publish; the pipeline refuses to run while a required value is null.

region.description: Region used to sign requests to the endpoint.

volumeExtentsGeojson.description: Archival bundle of every layer at full precision.

volumeExtentsTopojson.description: Optimized TopoJSON read by the app (instance.json volumeExtentsFile).

coverageList.description: Splash-page place list (instance.json coverageDescriptiveList); null if the instance has none.
